entries.name: Skyrim
entries.content: Skyrim is a vast region set in the northern part of Tamriel. It is the home of the Nords, large and hardy men and women who have a strong resistance to frost, both natural and magical.

entries.name: Tamriel
entries.content: Tamriel is the continent where Skyrim and nine other regions are located.

entries.name: Daedra
entries.content: The Daedra are powerful, god-like beings who inhabit the planes of Oblivion. The Daedra are often associated with chaos, unpredictability, and a disregard for mortal life. Despite their malevolent reputation, many mortals form cults to worship and seek favors from the Daedra, though these dealings often come at great personal cost. The Daedra are both feared and revered, representing the darker forces at play in Tamriel.

entries.name: Daedric Princes
entries.content: The Daedric Princes, the most powerful of the Daedra, each rule over their own realms of Oblivion, embodying aspects such as destruction, madness or domination.

entries.name: Oblivion
entries.content: Oblivion is an extension of the Void and is considered the dualistic inverse of Aetherius, the utopian afterlife. The areas of Oblivion that are generally dark, depressing and chaotic in nature

entries.name: Harkon Volkihar
entries.content: Harkon Volkihar is a powerful vampire with dark skin, black hair and beard, and red eyes. He rules vampires from the shadows, and his purpose is to extinguish the sun with a powerful ritual so that the world is covered in shadows.
